verdict.rationale: DBOS documents an official, first-party MCP server that lets an LLM or agent connect to tools that analyze and manage DBOS workflows (dbos-docs-14), and the probe confirms it at docs.dbos.dev/integrations/mcp (dbos-probe-3). That covers the core of the story, but the evidence only shows a one-line description. Missing for 10: setup and connection instructions, an enumerated tool list and scope (e.g., which workflow, queue or Conductor operations are exposed), auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
